annotations.title: Do this question’s Google winners also win the AI answer?

description: Use when the user is deciding between SEO and AI-visibility (GEO) work, or asks whether ranking in Google gets them cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity: "we rank #2 on Google, why don’t AI answers cite us?". Returns Google’s top 10 organic domains for one question, how many of them four AI assistants cite across eight answers, the domains only the AI cites (the sources to earn coverage in), and, if a domain is given, its Google rank and AI citation count. Refuses before you are charged if either side cannot be measured. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.74 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $1.06 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For who owns the answers across a whole category, use run_answer_share.
